cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the NBE runs or oversees a national switch. Ethiopia joined PAPSS on 15 October 2026 with its institutions still to connect.
cells.note: The NBE licenses payment system operators and instrument issuers, ZooryaPay among them (October 2026). No national switch has been found, and the PAPSS membership of 15 October 2026 reports no live participation, which the study does not count.
